question: Will the Oleshky truce hold, yes or no?

lines.text: A ceasefire has begun in Russian occupied Oleshky, in southern Ukraine.
It started at three a.m. Kyiv time, and is due to last through Saturday.
The Kremlin says so far there have been no reports of violations.

scene.quote: So far there have been no reports of violations.

lines.text: Ukraine's negotiator Dmytro Lubinets says Kyiv is keeping its side.

scene.quote: I confirm that the Ukrainian side is honouring its commitments.

lines.text: Oleshky sits on the Dnipro River, across from Ukrainian held Kherson.
About twenty four thousand lived there before the war. AP says up to two thousand remain.
The UN says they cannot leave, because of mines and drone attacks.
The BBC reports many residents have been cooking garden weeds to survive.
It says the town has had no electricity, gas or water for three years.
Doctors, food and water go in first. Evacuation is planned for Friday.
Melania Trump brokered the deal, after Pope Leo urged aid.
But the truce is local. Minutes after it began, Russia fired ballistic missiles at Kyiv.
A Kherson official says it is too early to judge.
Aid goes in this week. Will the Oleshky truce hold, yes or no?

sources.title: Local ceasefire in besieged Oleshky begins, Ukrainian, Russian officials say

caption: Oleshky, Kherson, Ukraine: a local ceasefire began in Russian-occupied Oleshky at 3am, brokered by Melania Trump, so aid can go in and civilians can get out. The Kremlin says no violations so far, while Russian missiles still hit Kyiv. Will the Oleshky truce hold, yes or no?
notes_full: Truce began 27 Oct 01:00 UTC; first reported about 01:20 UTC (France 24 01:22, Ukrainska Pravda 01:20, NBC 01:42, Reuters 02:00, Al Jazeera 02:34, BBC and Kyiv Independent 02:58); about 10h old at render
Population: AP and Al Jazeera say up to 2,000 remain; BBC gives Ukraine's estimate of about 6,000 incl. 200 children; video uses the AP figure, attributed
Removal-risk: events and statements only, all attributed, no death toll (Kyiv and Kharkiv casualties left out), no future-attack framing, both sides quoted, neutral yes/no
